audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 6/10 does not match the mirror's resolved 5.5/10, and the two prose fields that quote the number would then disagree with the enum.
audit.why: The mirror (kled__swain) settled this lane as EVEN at 5.5/10 with carry threat 8/10 on their side; diff is already EVEN here, only the number is out of step.
audit.corrected: diffRating 5.5/10, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t updated so all three read the same number.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Swain/Skill/Kled/Kled/Swain/Kled/Kled; the packet and the mirror both give Swain/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Swain.
audit.why: Level 2 is where Bear Trap on a Rope arrives and flips the lane — the page's own whys[1] and spikes[1] say exactly that, so 'Skill' is wrong. Level 6 belongs to Kled because Chaaaaaaaarge!!! arrives with a shield and a remount that cut the drain short. Two items is Swain's, per whys[6].
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs; ratings realigned; the level-6 and two-item whys rewritten to agree with their new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s shield is never mentioned, no cooldowns appear anywhere, and Violent Tendencies' auto-attack reset is described only as 'burst' with no tell.
audit.why: Riot text: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s, charges to a location, and grants a shield — it absorbs the burst window you were about to commit. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s at 800 range and yanks the target toward him after the shackle. Violent Tendencies is 13/12/11/10/9s of massive attack speed for four attacks — the wind-up is the cue, not the cast. Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, phases[1]/[4]/[6].why, whys[4] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Track Bear Trap on a Rope' is repeated everywhere without ever giving its length, so the advice cannot be acted on.
audit.why: 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s at rank 5 is the actual window, and it is the difference between a free E-root and a dead Swain.
audit.corrected: Number written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and phases[1].why.

edits.before: E-root into the pull is your whole kill setup. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap comes online at 11s and flips the lane — one hook into Violent Tendencies chunks you before E exists.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension turns his all-in into your healing — bait it, then drain. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! arrives with a shield on a 140s cooldown and a remount behind it — your drain gets cut short unless you bait it first.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Kled carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: fragment bulk and Demonflare delete an overcommitting Kled — you finally own the side-lane attrition.

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Root/dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope: 11s at rank 1, 800 range — the yank is his engage, so sidestep the rope. - Violent Tendencies: 13s, four fast attacks; the wind-up is the tell. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s and it shields him — bait it out.

edits.before: Track Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope: His engage hook. Root/dodge it. When it is down — E-root + R him.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11s and yanks you in; Chaaaaaaaarge!!! shields him for 140s. Bait both, then E-root and drain.

edits.before: His engage hook. Root/dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage hook, 11s at rank 1 and 800 range. Sidestep the rope.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Dismounted Kled hurts less — finish him before courage remounts Skaarl.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Bear Trap on a Rope and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Bear Trap on a Rope and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Kled carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Kled carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Kled's Chaaaaarge engage plus Skaarl remount mechanics means even a well-executed R drain can be cut short by a second mounted burst window — respect his Level 6 kill threat.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s but it lands with a shield, and remounting Skaarl hands him a second mounted burst window — a clean R drain still gets cut short unless you force the shield out first.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension lets you absorb a full mounted Kled all-in and flip it: bait him into R range, pop Demonflare when his Beartrap is on cooldown.
edits.after: Demonic Ascension can absorb a mounted all-in, but Chaaaaaaaarge!!! shields straight through it — bait the shield first, then Demonflare while Bear Trap is down.
